posts.author: GreenOx97
posts.body:
Hi
So, I've been using galv's parallax mapping plugin for my project and it's been working perfectly up until now.
But I've suddenly hit a problem where the layer on my latest map is now on covering about a quarter of the screen. As in, the layer is shrunk down and isn't lined up with the rest of the map.
It is a larger map than normal, is it that the reason why? It's worked fine up until now. I've posted a pic of what i mean.
For reference, my map is 50 x 70, and this is the script I've put in the notes: LAYER_S 0 redvalley 0 0 255 0.5 10 0 0
I've just copy and pasted that script from my other maps that are working.
I've been using gimp to create my maps, is it perhaps something with the export settings? Still works fine when I try it on new test maps, copy and paste the same script and everything.

posts.author: Plueschkatze
posts.body:
Is your parallax map the right size for your map resolution?
Your parallax maps would need to be 2400x3360 to fit a 50x70 map.
(50 x 48 and 70 x 48 if you use the 48px grid)
Also your plugin call seems to be a little messed up.
Simplest version of the call, if you don't use parallax offsets or anything:
Calling from an event:
LAYER_S MAPID ID GRAPHIC X Y OPACITY Z BLEND
Used in Maps Notes:
LAYER_S ID GRAPHIC X Y OPACITY Z BLEND
Based on these your Z depth would be 0.5 (I think it's full numbers only? but I might be incorrect)
negative and 0 are below the tileset, 1 is above the tileset, 5 and higher above the player
Your blend mode would be 10, which doesn't exist.
Blend modes are:
Blend mode (0 = normal, 1 = add, 2 = multiply, 3 = screen)
*NOTE RPG Maker MV version 1.1 mutliply isn't supported
Also if you just saved the maps via rightclick onto the maps to explort them, those are never to scale. You'd need a plugin that actually exports them in 1:1 scale, like orange mapshots for RPGMaker MV. (not sure if there's a MZ version or if it would still work in MZ or via Fossil)
